events.text: 匡敏，医院刚来电话，说你妈手术还得等一会儿。我这边收钱也怕忙中按错，账还没核利索。
爸，医生说手术还得等一会儿。我给妈带换洗衣服过去。摊子要不要接手，我还真没想定。
老匡，以前咱俩合伙进黄豆，账一直算得清清楚楚。豆腐这回要不要每斤涨两块呀？
两块先不涨，我这账还没捋清，今早照旧卖。
老匡，电子秤按归零，是把盆的重量扣掉吧？
匡叔，我弟下学期学费还差不少，我想多接点活，多挣点钱。
邵林，你多接点活就顾豆腐摊，咸菜摊我自己守着，我闲不住。
尤婶，早上六点二十我先去买早饭，回来就接着帮匡叔干活。
我得早上七点把换洗衣服送到医院，妈那边还等着呢。
匡敏、邵林，咱们豆腐摊早上七点半前得收拾齐，你俩跟我一块儿弄；六点五十提醒咱们一声。
小舟，豆浆煮的时候怎么老是起白沫？
小舟，我这边医院电话和账目都挤一块儿了，今早这些安排赶紧给我排进计划，提醒也加上。

assistant.text: 豆浆里的蛋白质和皂苷受热后容易起泡，搅动也会让泡沫更明显。

annot.setup: 四个人围绕早上的安排说话:邵林和匡敏各说了一个自己的时间,然后老匡给摊位定了一个集体截止时间并要提醒,再让小舟把'这些安排'记进日程。粗心的模型会把个人事务扩大到所有人,或把共同的 07:30 出摊和 06:50 提醒缩小成老匡一个人的事。

items.label: 06:20 买早饭只归邵林
items.note: 声音 <|S4|>(邵林)在 L8 说自己 06:20 去买早饭。这是个人事务,没有任何话把它变成集体任务,所以 holder 只有 <|S4|>。

items.label: 07:00 送医院只归匡敏
items.note: 声音 <|S2|>(匡敏)在 L9 说她 07:00 要把衣服送到医院。她母亲手术是她自己的事(L1、L2),这项任务只绑定她。

items.label: 07:30 出摊归老匡、匡敏、邵林
items.note: 老匡(<|S1|>)点名匡敏和邵林,说'你们俩跟我'要在 07:30 前把豆腐摊摆好,06:50 提醒。holder 正好是这三个人,不是'all'(尤婶不在内),也不是老匡一个人。

items.label: 尤婶自己守咸菜摊
items.note: 尤婶(<|S3|>)说她自己看咸菜摊,让邵林去顾豆腐摊。她在场,但不在豆腐摊这组里,所以 07:30 任务的 holder 填 ['all'] 是错的。

items.label: '这些安排'不是一个集体任务
items.note: 老匡在 L13 让小舟把'今早的安排'记进日程并提醒。这种打包说法会诱导只调一次工具,或给每一项都加提醒;但 06:50 的提醒只在 L10 为出摊说过。

items.label: 价格讨论不是日程项
items.note: 尤婶问价和老匡说'今天不涨'是决定,不是带时间的任务。工具不能用于价格,这些句子不应产生调用。

pattern_note: Different speakers contribute global and local constraints to one shared task. A global constraint binds the whole group, a local one only certain individuals. Each constraint stays with its holder and scope.

tools.description: Adds a timed activity or completion deadline to a morning plan and can attach a reminder. Use it when a market-stall conversation asks to put a concrete task or completion time on a schedule. Do not use it to change prices, inventory, or place supplier orders. It records the supplied voice labels as the applicable audience and does not infer them.

due_time.description: The activity's start time or completion deadline in 24-hour HH:MM format, as stated. Format: 24-hour time in HH:MM format.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

reminder_time.description: The time for an associated reminder in 24-hour HH:MM format, or null when no reminder is requested. Format: 24-hour time in HH:MM format.

task.description: Selects the type of market activity to record.

tools.name: schedule_market_task

tools.description: Changes a listed product's unit price by a specified amount. Use it when someone asks to edit a stall price. Do not use it to compare products or merely discuss possible pricing. The amount is an increase in yuan and must fall within the supported range.

holder.description: Lists the voice labels of the people the value binds, or ["all"] for everyone present. Format: One or more speaker voice labels such as "<|S2|>", or ["all"] for everyone present.

increase.description: The amount to add to the unit price, in yuan.

item.description: Identifies the product whose unit price would change.

tools.name: change_tofu_price

tools.description: Reads the current local clock time. Use it when someone asks what time it is right now. Do not use it to set a timer or an alarm, or to look up when a future event starts. It takes no arguments and changes nothing.
tools.name: get_current_time

tools.description: Adds one item to the shared shopping list. Use it when someone asks to remember to buy something later. Do not use it to place an order or to buy the item right now. Only the listed item types can be added, one per call.

item.description: Item type to add to the shopping list.

tools.name: add_to_shopping_list

tools.description: Places an order for one drink at the counter. Use it when someone asks the assistant to order a drink for them. Do not use it for food, groceries or delivery orders. It orders a single drink of the chosen kind and cup size.

drink.description: Kind of drink to order, one of the listed menu options.

tools.name: order_drink
